title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer of 7.75 km must be clearly stated.

title: Correct Formula
description: Important Criteria: The formula for angular resolution, theta = 1.22 * lambda / D, must be correctly applied.

title: Distance Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of distance using the resolved angle must be shown correctly.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The units must be consistent throughout the calculations, particularly in converting wavelengths and distances.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes in the calculations or incorrect application of the formula will lead to a deduction.
